Comunidade da UMinho com acesso gratuito à plataforma IAedu
Diretrizes sobre a utilização responsável da IA generativa na investigação

claimChanges.claimText: IAedu is listed for University of Minho in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

An official UMinho SASUM notice says the University of Minho community has free protected access to IAedu in a pilot phase, can authenticate with institutional credentials, and that the initiative is framed as responsible and secure because data are not used to train AI language models.

University of Minho Open Science guidance summarizes responsible generative-AI use in research, including human responsibility for research outputs, reporting generative-AI use, avoiding import of sensitive information into AI tools, and not using these tools for tasks with direct impact on third parties such as peer review or proposal evaluation.
